executive_summary: On May 1, 2026, OFAC added one individual to the SDN list under the DRCONGO program. Kabila Joseph Kabange, a resident of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was designated due to his involvement in activities related to the program. This addition highlights the ongoing efforts to target individuals contributing to instability in the region.

notable_entities.name: Kabila Joseph Kabange
notable_entities.significance: Individual designated under the DRCONGO program for contributing to instability in the region
